name: Senpen Banka Hyaku Fushigi
source:
The protagonist, Futsu Kanzaka, whose hobby is collecting urban legends, enrolled in an academy famous for its abundance of ghost stories—but hidden there was a strangeness overflowing with long-standing grudges and conspiracies.
Out of curiosity, Futsu begins investigating the academy’s “Hundred Mysteries,” but before long he will throw himself into a battle against an orchestrated grudge. Where did it all begin? As various motives intertwine, what will Futsu choose in the end...?
“Even if all else is forgotten in time, I alone shall remember.”

Translated from the official website.
translation:
以搜集都市传说为爱好的主人公神坂布津，入读了一所以怪谈众多而闻名的学园——殊不知学园深处暗藏着充斥着陈年宿怨与重重阴谋的诡异怪异。
出于好奇，布津着手调查学园流传的“百大不可思议”，却在不知不觉间投身进一场对抗人为操纵之怨念的激战之中。这一切究竟始于何处？当各方企图交错纠葛之际，布津最终又将作何抉择……？
“纵使世间万物终随岁月被遗忘，唯独我一人会永远铭记。”

[译自官方网站]
